works.title: How I Built the Oracle Process: The Keys to the Oracle's Lock
works.description: A planned fiction book using a keys/doors parable structure to introduce the Oracle concept through narrative. The user describes walking readers through the experience of building the Oracle via a layered story with reflective koan-like elements at each door.
works.quote: When I write fiction about this and walk people through this experience, I'm going to call it "How I Built the Oracle Process: The Keys to the Oracle's Lock."

works.title: Future of Work: Tech Monopolies, Organizational Change, and the Collapse of Competitive Moats
works.description: A book examining the future of AI, the Internet, and work in general. Explores how tech companies have used DMCA and enclosure strategies to build silos, and speculates on organizational shrinkage (80% workforce reduction for most enterprises), economies of scale, and how text-first frameworks resist traditional software lock-in.
works.quote: I want to discuss the last chapter or second-to-last chapter where I talk about the future of AI, the Internet, and work in general. I already know how I want to frame it. Anyone who has been in tech development over the last 30 years has been trying to figure out how to build a silo they can enclose and operate as a gatekeeper.
